english.note: Use this for sustained physical or mental energy, especially when describing a person rather than an action.

examples.english: They can still play with their children after working all day; they are really vigorous.
examples.traditional: 佢做完成日嘅嘢仲可以陪仔女玩，真係精力充沛。
